posts.author: Sculptor jim
posts.content_md:
Hello all; I was shining a pencil laser into a cheap cut glass crystal (gold paint on the bottom facets)

when something strange appeared. It looked like a small sine wave that was definitely 3D. I moved my head and it allowed me to see

it from differing perspectives. The pic I've attached is a doctored photo that shows approximately what I saw. I put it down and forgot about it until a day later. 

Now I cannot recreate the apparition. Does anyone know what I stumbled upon?

Thanks in advance.

Jim

posts.author: Dinesh
posts.content_md:
O My Gawd! You've accidentally discovered the Holy Grail! Einstein hypothesised this phenomenon as a gateway to another galaxy, but he was never able to do it. There are some who say Einstein was from another galaxy and came here via the crystal phenomenon you discovered! really!

I'm joking! I'm joking! What's probably happening is that there are a series of micro-cracks inside the crystal. This may create a "pathway" of a different index by connecting the micro-cracks - a sort of "optical gulf stream" within the body of the crystal. The light scatters off the cracks and follows the small - but different - index change inside the crystal. In this case, you probably cannot recreate it because you have to hit the crystal at exactly the same position at exactly the same angle in order to launch the light into this series of micrcracks. It seems 3D because the micro-crack pathway exists within the body of a transparent crystal.
